title: HANGING LIBRARY PROJECT
summary: Rotary Club of Mumbai Horizons, in association with Ratna Nidhi Foundation, implemented a Hanging Library Project at The Public High School, Kandivali East, on 19th October 2026.
description: Rotary Club of Mumbai Horizons, in association with Ratna Nidhi Foundation, implemented a Hanging Library Project at The Public High School, Kandivali East, on 19th October 2026. This District Initiative aims to encourage reading habits among students and make books easily accessible to young learners. The project reflects Rotary's commitment to promoting education and nurturing young minds.
